ThingDef.label: wraith grav engine seed
ThingDef.description: A dense Wraith organ-seed carrying the developmental pattern of a full grav engine. Implant it into a living biological prisoner or slave, or into a biological humanlike corpse. The host is consumed and, after one day, yields a minified Wraith grav engine ready for installation.

li.commandDescription: Implant this seed into a living biological prisoner or slave, or a biological humanlike corpse. After one day the host is converted into a Wraith grav engine.

ThingDef.label: incubating living forge mass
ThingDef.description: A biological corpse consumed by Wraith host-seed tissue. Keep the mass spawned on the map while it converts; after one day it becomes a minified living forge.

li.completionMessage: The corpse-incubated living forge has finished growing.

ThingDef.label: incubating grav engine mass
ThingDef.description: A biological humanlike corpse being reorganized by a Wraith grav engine seed. Keep the mass spawned on the map; after one day it yields a minified Wraith grav engine.

li.completionMessage: The corpse-incubated Wraith grav engine has finished growing.
